items.stem: A Power Automate flow called from the agent updates a Dataverse record but can be triggered twice for one request. What design choice keeps this safe?

options.text: Make the action idempotent so a repeat run does not double-apply
options.rationale: Correct: idempotent actions tolerate retries and duplicate triggers without side effects.

options.text: Remove all error handling to simplify the flow
options.rationale: Removing error handling makes duplicate and failed runs more dangerous, not safer.
No logging hides failures; it does not prevent double-application.

options.text: Give the flow a longer timeout only
options.rationale: A longer timeout does not stop a duplicate trigger from applying twice.

items.explanation: Correct: idempotent actions tolerate retries and duplicate triggers without side effects.

items.stem: Which TWO controls keep a generative service agent safe before it changes a customer account? (Select TWO.)

options.text: A human-confirmation step before the irreversible action
options.rationale: Correct: confirmation gives a person the chance to stop a wrong action.

options.text: Least-privilege security roles on the data it can write
options.rationale: Correct: limiting write access bounds the damage any single action can do.

options.text: Allowing the agent to self-approve high-risk actions
options.rationale: Self-approval removes the oversight the control is meant to provide.

options.text: Publishing to all users before any pilot
options.rationale: Skipping a monitored pilot increases, not reduces, release risk.

items.explanation: Correct: confirmation gives a person the chance to stop a wrong action.

items.stem: Why should a Copilot Studio generative answer be grounded on an approved knowledge source?

options.text: To keep answers tied to vetted, current content rather than unverified output
options.rationale: Correct: grounding constrains answers to approved material and reduces fabrication.

options.text: Because grounding disables all generative behaviour
options.rationale: Grounding steers generation; it does not disable it.

options.text: Because it removes the need for any testing
options.rationale: Grounded answers still require testing and review.

options.text: Because it guarantees legal compliance automatically
options.rationale: Compliance depends on the content and review, not grounding alone.

items.explanation: Correct: grounding constrains answers to approved material and reduces fabrication.
